mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% and the correlation between FEDFUNDS and returns is negative but insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index above 225.0 signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting central bank tightening and reducing real equity returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225.0, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls indicate a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE falling below 8.0% and PAYEMS rising above 131,000 thousand is not associated with positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, rising housing starts signal strong consumer demand and confidence, which translates into higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is rising, or the correlation between HOUST and returns is negative and significant (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 95.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 95.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 630.0 signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 630.0, or the correlation between HOUST and returns is negative (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate and low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 225.0) signals a favorable monetary environment that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and CPIAUCSL < 225.0 does not yield positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of industrial production (above 95.0) indicates strong economic output and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 95.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and returns is below 0.03.
